name: Jump Guide
description: A clean side timing bar that shows exactly when to press and when to hold. Copy your layout in the editor, play it, and follow the bar: segments slide down to the trigger line, turn green when you press on time, and grow while you hold.

view-distance.name: View Distance (blocks)
view-distance.description: How far ahead the bar looks. Lower = segments move faster.

press-offset.name: Press Offset (ms)
press-offset.description: How early the segment reaches the line before the obstacle.

scroll-grid.name: Scrolling Grid
scroll-grid.description: Faint lines that scroll with your speed.

danger-ids.name: Spike Object IDs
danger-ids.description: Comma separated object IDs counted as obstacles. Copy again after changing.

hold-channel.name: Hold Marker Color Channel
hold-channel.description: Blocks using this color channel become hold segments. 0 disables. Copy again after changing.

merge-gap.name: Merge Gap (blocks)
merge-gap.description: Spikes closer than this become one segment.
